title: Equivariance Allows Handling Multiple Nuisance Variables When Analyzing Pooled Neuroimaging Datasets
reasoning: The paper directly addresses the ethical concept of fairness in machine learning. Section 4.1, 'Obtaining Fair Representations,' details experiments on standard fairness datasets (German and Adult) where sensitive attributes like gender and foreigner status are treated as nuisance variables to be mitigated. This constitutes a direct evaluation and application of a method for an ethical AI principle, rather than a cursory mention.
